description:
Check whether a Stripe checkout session has been paid and execute the next step.
Call this after presenting the checkoutUrl to the user. If status is "pending", wait a few seconds and call again.
- If called after submit_lookup: once status is "done" call check_lookup with the returned jobId.
- If called after audience_start_run: once status is "done" call audience_download_run with the returned runId.

sessionId.description: The sessionId returned by submit_lookup or audience_start_run when payment was required

name: check_payment
